Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) to identify interactors of ZFC3H1 variants. While the PRIDE metadata lists some PTM strings (acetylated residue), the methods text describes a standard bottom-up DDA LFQ workflow for protein interactome analysis without specific PTM enrichment (like phospho or ubiquitylome). The 'PTM-enriched' mode is selected here as a general category for AP-MS based on the provided ontology context for modifier routing, but specifically, it is an AP-MS workflow.

scope: To interrogate the effect of these point mutations on the interactome of the ZFC3H1 N terminus, we generated wild-type (WT) (Z11-209(WT)) and mutant (Z11-209(MUT)) MYC-tagged variants and subjected them to immunoprecipitation (IP) followed by mass spectrometry (IP-MS).

After affinity enrichment, eluted proteins were precipitated on MagResyn HILIC beads in 70% acetonitrile, washed in 95% acetonitrile and 70% ethanol to remove detergents and digested with trypsin and Lys-C.
Cleared lysates were incubated with Pierce anti-c-MYC magnetic beads (Thermo Scientific) or ChromoTek GFP-Trap Magnetic Particles M-270 (Proteintech) overnight at 4°C.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The mass spectrometry analysis was performed on proteins affinity-purified via immunoprecipitation of MYC-tagged ZFC3H1 variants.
